action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Shears attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Shears
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) force damage. If the target is a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the hag's next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the hag fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Trace the Threads (1/Day)
entries: The hag can cast the {@spell Legend Lore} spell, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
